items.title: BIMSTEC Home Ministers adopt the Delhi Declaration
items.text: India hosted the first BIMSTEC Home Ministers' meeting in New Delhi. Delegations from all seven member states adopted the Delhi Declaration and agreed to improve regional coordination and cooperation on shared challenges.

items.title: IMF raises India's FY2026-27 growth forecast to 7%
items.text: The International Monetary Fund raised its growth forecast for India for the 2026-27 financial year from 6.4% to 7%, citing stronger domestic demand and services activity.

items.title: World Standards Day is observed on 14 October
items.text: World Standards Day recognises the work of experts who develop international standards. The 2026 theme highlights how standards can support affordable and clean energy, linked to Sustainable Development Goal 7.

items.title: Indian Railways prepares extra services for the festive rush
items.text: Indian Railways has announced plans for about 3.4 lakh regular train trips and more than 8,000 special train trips to help manage travel demand during Durga Puja, Diwali and Chhath.

items.title: Indian markets monitor oil prices and quarterly earnings
items.text: Market coverage on 14 October highlighted elevated crude oil prices and upcoming company earnings as factors investors were watching at the start of the trading session. Market indicators can change during the day.
